meta.source: Ndugu Final Logical Framework with Dashboard indicators, October 2026
meta.vision: Ndugu Farmers is Uganda's leading channel partner of traceable, sustainable coffee by organizing, digitizing and transforming medium sized cooperatives and aggregators into social (people) and sustainable (planet) agribusinesses (profit)

indicators.text: # of Ndugu partner cooperatives that have adopted digital systems for their production and financial records
indicators.mov: Cooperative membership and trading records; M&E reports (written, video, audio)
indicators.caveat: Counts cooperatives that appear in the digital transaction exports. It shows who is trading through the system, not whether each has also digitised its financial records, which the logframe indicator requires. Confirm with a cooperative checklist.

indicators.text: % of Ndugu farmers accessing financing / input loans through cooperative channels (SACCOs and VSLAs)
indicators.caveat: The microfinance book records loans per cooperative, not how many individual farmers borrowed through SACCOs and VSLAs, so the share of farmers cannot be calculated yet. Context shown is the value already lent.

indicators.text: % increase in amount of coffee sourced from Ndugu farmers since 2023
indicators.mov: Ndugu financial records incl. weekly performance reports; Ndugu Impact coffee production and trading reports
indicators.caveat: The indicator is measured since 2023, but the exports start in May 2024, so there is no 2023 baseline. The figure shown is season 2025 against season 2024 volume sourced. Add the 2023 volume to measure it as defined.

indicators.text: % of Ndugu farmers earning income through diversification, e.g. macadamia or bee products
indicators.target_text: USD 500,000 revenue from other products by 2028
indicators.mov: Ndugu financial records; M&E reports (written, video, audio)
indicators.caveat: The baseline asked who already grows macadamia or keeps bees, not who earns income from them. Only 29 respondents had sold any macadamia. Treat this as the starting point for the income indicator, not the indicator itself.

indicators.text: % of Ndugu farmers who adopted regenerative agricultural practices
indicators.caveat: No data source yet. This indicator needs the M&E survey of farmers.

indicators.text: % of Ndugu farmers who adopted regenerative agroforestry
indicators.caveat: A baseline from 1,560 surveyed farmers, before the programme's agroforestry work. The survey asks about any agroforestry, not specifically the regenerative practices the logframe defines, and the logframe target for this indicator needs confirming.

indicators.mov: Cooperative membership and trading records; M&E reports (written, video, audio)
indicators.caveat: No data source yet. This indicator needs the M&E survey of farmers.

indicators.text: % of Ndugu farmers that are certified by a relevant standard and can be traced
indicators.mov: Certification reports and certified farmer database; cooperative membership records
indicators.caveat: Certification is counted over the 5,591 farmers in the inspection file, not the whole register. 431 of the recorded certificates were filled as 'yes' during cleaning and should be confirmed against the certified farmer database. The target is met on certification; traceability (mapped plots) is still below it.
